name: Dental — Private practice
description: A complete private-practice website for PremiumCMS: treatments with fees and online deposits, one-minute booking against clinician availability, signed new-patient intake forms, a before/after smile gallery, live Google reviews, FAQ structured data, a cookie-consent banner and a small dental shop. Seeds the booking plugin (treatments, team, reminders, 6-month recalls), the forms and the Site Kit Dentist profile. Served by PremiumCMS as is, or forked to GitHub Pages with one-click theme updates.
